_comment: Stock photos bundled into public/img, all from Unsplash under the Unsplash licence (free for commercial use, no permission needed). 'unsplash' is the photo id from images.unsplash.com/photo-<id>. Keys without an id fall back to their group's photo in the app; add an id and run `npm run images` to fill one in.
